verdict.rationale: Ledgy's documented GraphQL API exposes only read operations: auth, companyCaptable and companyTransactions for retrieving cap table data. Nothing shows a write or mutation surface for drafting option grants, or any board-approval queue reachable programmatically. Bulk granting is described only as an in-app workflow, which does not count as an agent-accessible programmatic surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can draft securities (e.g. option grants) via the platform's programmatic surface and leave them queued for human board approval
